content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. PayPal can suspend your account—and your funds—for 180 days without appeal. If you’re a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or any of the 149 countries where these platforms are unavailable or unreliable, your infrastructure options are not workarounds. They are base-layer replacements. This comparison analyzes the actual [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-23|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-13|The Real]] required to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-17|ebooks]], courses, or digital products without depending on platforms that exclude you. The solution is not another payment gateway. It is sovereign commerce infrastructure you own.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle bundle hosting, payment processing, and delivery into a single interface. They are convenient—until they reject your country or suspend your account. Sovereign commerce stacks decouple these layers. You host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free), handle payments via NOWPayments (0.5% fee), and deliver files from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). The backend runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can suspend your access because no platform is required to operate.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on compliance, risk, or geopolitical factors. Their terms of service explicitly list prohibited regions. Sovereign infrastructure ignores these restrictions because it operates at the protocol layer. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC, and your store runs on globally accessible infrastructure like Cloudflare. The architecture is permissionless by design. Your customers pay in USDT, USDC, or SOL, and the transaction confirms on-chain without intermediaries. The system does not care where you are located—only that the payment is valid.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal holds funds for 30 days or more in high-risk accounts. Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments, which charges 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10 in gas. The tradeoff is volatility: you must decide whether to accept stablecoins or native tokens. The infrastructure itself is free to deploy. GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets cost $0. The only expense is the NOWPayments fee and your initial setup cost if you purchase a stack like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes deployment, testing, and 30-day support.
Platforms exclude you. Protocols do not. Build on infrastructure no one can restrict.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, your payment history, and your delivery mechanism. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your order data lives in Supabase or Google Sheets. Your files are delivered via signed URLs from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The automation runs on serverless functions you control. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You are not renting infrastructure—you are owning it. This model eliminates platform lock-in, subscription fees, and the risk of sudden account termination.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you sell fewer than 5 products and prioritize speed, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments in 48 hours. For enterprise-grade automation, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. If you prefer to self-deploy, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. The choice depends on your technical skill, product volume, and tolerance for manual configuration. All options deliver infrastructure sovereignty—the permanent alternative to platform dependency.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries is a sovereign commerce stack. Deploy GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions entirely. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No country-based exclusions apply because the system operates on globally accessible protocols. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes end-to-end deployment and testing for creators who prefer a managed solution.
Owning your stack means no one can suspend your account—or your funds.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack with these steps: (1) Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. (2) Set up your backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. (3) Configure your database: Supabase or Google Sheets. (4) Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. (5) Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. (6) Test end-to-end: payment, webhook, and file delivery. (7) Deploy and own your infrastructure. For managed deployment, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I sell in my local currency with a sovereign stack?
Yes. Accept stablecoins like USDT or USDC pegged to the USD, or native tokens like SOL or BNB. Convert to your local currency via decentralized exchanges.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your store remains operational. NOWPayments is replaceable with any crypto payment gateway. The stack’s architecture is protocol-based, not provider-dependent.
Do I need to know how to code?
Basic technical skill is required for self-deployment. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes full documentation. For managed deployment, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Use stablecoins to minimize volatility risk. Include clear refund policies in your store terms.
Can I scale this infrastructure?
Yes. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase scale to enterprise levels. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes scaling playbooks for high-volume stores.
Sovereign commerce is not a workaround. It is base-layer architecture for the financially isolated.
